Shadow mode day one."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-automode ⚡"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Claude Code–style auto mode for DeepSeek Harness** — let your agent run hands-free, while a determ"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"inistic guardrail and a cost-aware reviewer keep the dangerous stuff from ever executing."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 🌐 **简体中文**: README.zh.md · **English**: README.md"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@log.li/dsh-automode) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@log.li/dsh-"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"automode) [](./LICENSE) [](https://github.com/log-li/dsh-automode) [](https://github.com/log-li/dsh-"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"automode) [](https://github.com/log-li/dsh-automode) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"dsh-automode sits between your agent and the harness. It intercepts every tool call **before executi"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"on** — hard `deny` rules and curated `allowPaths` decide deterministically (zero LLM cost), and what"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ever is left goes to a two-stage classifier. Safe actions run on their own; risky ones are blocked, "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"reshaped, or routed to you."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ Key features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 🛡️ **Deterministic first line** — regex `deny` bands hard-block exfiltration, secrets, and system "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"paths before any LLM call; prefix-glob `allow` rules approve routine commands for free.
- ⚡ **Zero-c"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"onfirmation allowlist** — `config.allowPaths` is full trust: file ops and bash writes inside it skip"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" the classifier entirely, and escalated calls are auto-granted through the approval bridge (v0.10.0)"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" — no prompt, no round-trip.
- 🧠 **Cost-aware two-stage classifier** — a one-token filter pre-screen"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"s; only flagged actions get the structured review, and identical actions reuse the verdict cache for"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" 5 minutes.
- 🔁 **Circuit breaker + human fallback** — 3 consecutive (or 20 total) DENYs pause auto "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"mode and route decisions to a human; one human decision resumes and resets.
- 📜 **Full audit trail**"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" — every allow / deny / bridge decision is appended to `~/.dsh/auto-mode/decisions.jsonl`.
- 🔌 **Nat"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ive preset** — flip it on from the permission picker or `/auto`; it plays nicely alongside read-only"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" / workspace-write / danger-full-access."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Not a sandbox.** The plugin runs inside the DSH process; a deliberately malicious plugin can "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"do anything your user account can do. It reduces unsafe autonomous tool use — it is not an OS securi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"your user account can do. The permission picker (bottom-left of the chat box) will show **"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"Auto mode** alongside read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Optional: the ⚡ glyph in the permission picker"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The `auto-mode` preset declares an `icon`, but **stock DSH ignores a preset's `icon` on both sides**"},{"id":"p16s2","text":": the host preset schema has no `icon` field and `optionOf()` forwards none, and the client bundle h"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ardcodes the three built-in glyphs. "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"Diagram source: `docs/auto-mode-flow.workflow.json`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The pre-execute gate intercepts ALL tool calls (including those inside the workspace sandbox that wo"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"uld never trigger the approval waterfall). The approval waterfall only runs for calls that actually "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"need sandbox escalation. The pre-execute gate only applies to **auto-mode** sessions; in other prese"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ts (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access) it is a no-op so it never contradicts the sand"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"box the user chose. Since 0.18.0 the gate also covers **sessions that inherit auto mode**: a subagen"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"t or AgentTeams worker whose own preset is unset is governed when an ancestor session (via its `pare"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ntSession` chain) is in auto mode. Such sessions get the deterministic layers only — they have no ap"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"proval answerer behind them, so the classifier is never asked — and the first covered call records a"},{"id":"p23s9","text":" `pre-execute-inherited` line in the audit log."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Compatibility & contributions"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"**Supported dsh versions: `0.1.0-rc.6` – `0.2.x`** (peer range `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.3.0-0`); the current"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" 0.2 line is tested on `0.2.1-rc.2`. Two caveats worth stating plainly:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- The peer range covers `0.2.x` **release** versions. npm's prerelease rule keeps every prerelease h"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ost — including the tested `0.2.1-rc.2` — outside a range whose comparators carry the `0.1.0-rc.6` p"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"reid; the previous `<0.2.0` bound behaved the same way for `0.1.7-rc.2`. `dsh plugin add` runs pnpm,"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" which **does** evaluate the range and prints an unmet-peer warning on such a host but still install"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"s; an npm-style install against a prerelease host fails with `ERESOLVE`.
- `npm run typecheck` compi"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"les against this repo's dev dependency (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 0.1.0-rc.8), not against the host you r"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"un. Pointed at `0.2.1-rc.2`'s `.d.ts`, tsc reports type drift in the v3 compatibility branch (its `C"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ontentBlockMap` no longer has `tool-result`) and in the `agent/created` handler's return type. Both "},{"id":"p29s9","text":"are compile-time only: the branch is unreachable on 0.2.x and the handler returns `undefined`, which"},{"id":"p29s10","text":" the new mode accepts. | `≥ 0"},{"id":"p32s2","text":".1.5-rc.1` | durable `permissions` session projection (`ctx.sessionProjections.stateOf`) |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"dsh `0.1.5-rc.1` removed the `session.events` accessor — without the projection path every auto-mode"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" turn died with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')` while the system prompt was"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" assembled (fixed in v0.11.2). Every host export the plugin probes for at runtime is present on `0.2"},{"id":"p33s4","text":".1-rc.2`: `setApprovalPolicy`, `setSandboxMode`, `PermissionPresetService` (with `current` / `set` /"},{"id":"p33s5","text":" `derive` / `optionOf`) and the service name `permissionPresets`."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
